data.one_liner: Flutter widgets to replace multiple nested StreamBuilder widgets with a single builder.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of StreamBuilder widgets (e.g., StreamBuilder3) that accept multiple streams and tuples of initial data, allowing you to handle multiple streams simultaneously in a single builder function instead of nesting multiple StreamBuilder widgets.
use_when: You need to listen to multiple streams within the same part of your UI.
You want to avoid deeply nested StreamBuilder boilerplate.
avoid_when: You are using a state management solution that already handles multiple streams or reactive state cleanly.
You only need to listen to a single stream.
strengths: Supports up to 15 streams using dedicated builders.
Simple declarative usage matching standard Flutter APIs.
weaknesses: Relies on custom tuple types instead of native collections for streams and initial data.
Limited to stream handling; not a full state management solution.
